resolution_policy.metadata_only: If every unmerged path is documentation/release metadata, take the replayed upstream commit version, count a metadata recovery event, and continue.
resolution_policy.implementation_or_mixed: Retain as hard replay failure with commit and unmerged paths.

interpretation: Metadata conflicts measure traceability/release-maintenance debt, not functional incompatibility.
